en: Living among ordinary people may still bring him pain at times. But one day he will surely find something.
Why he was born, why he has been allowed to live... I believe he will come to understand the answer by his own strength.
O small star of the great light...
May tenderness and great blessings be upon everyone who lives there, upon all of the world I love...
Even after the cursed blood released Clive, he went on living in the night, ruled by the moon and the dark.
He could find no other way to live. But he no longer fought out of the unhappy feelings of the past.
He fought on to live, and for a future where people could live. Only the moon could still see him now, fighting fiends in the dark where no one knew.
Long years went by, and the lone shadow against the night sky became a legend; in the tales he was told of for ages as a hero who lived in darkness...
Irene Tirnag: the time that had stood still for her began to move again.

Her memories no longer tormented her, but to carry on her grandfather's will she continued her travels and her research. It was also a journey to learn where she had come from and where she was going.
On her long travels, in the people and the landscapes she met, she found a future that no book contained.

They were small things: the warmth of people, the beauty of a sunset. But to her, those everyday sights felt like the future she had to protect. She sensed that her grandfather must have found the same on his travels.

Time passed, and when the days of fighting chaos had become distant memories, she returned to the tower. She took a young fledgling mage as her apprentice and passed on the knowledge she had inherited from her grandfather, together with his ideals.
Even after she leaves this world, those ideals will surely live on forever.
Back at the tower, Irene seems to have spent a while thinking about many things.
Through the journey to save the world, she was drawn, like it or not, into things she had always avoided.
There were many sad events, and she must have suffered... But surely she realised something there: that she is not alone...
That if she wishes for it, something warm is within her reach...
She may follow her grandfather's will again and lose herself in the study of magic. What will she see at the end of it...?
I believe it will be a shining future.
Still carrying her pain, Irene finished her journey and returned to the tower.
Life went on as before, and alone in the tower she set out to master magic.
The old solitary life was no hardship for her, and she spent her days calmly.
As time went by, her fame as a mage slowly grew, and she helped many people with her vast knowledge.
She always welcomed warmly the people who came to her for help.
She believed it was the one thing she could do...
Fein Lu Lugus: putting an end to his wandering, he set about rebuilding the mages' Guild.

On his journey he had learned that sins can only be atoned for by moving toward the future. Mistakes and sins, what was right and what was wrong: that is not in the past, but for the world ahead to decide.
Through his efforts the Guild slowly regained its old form. And he gave the teachings he had inherited from his master, and his own experience, to many young mages, and guided them.
Some years passed, and the mages of the restored Guild wished to welcome Fein as their new head.
But he firmly declined and set out on a journey again, to search for something: not the past, but the future.
No one knows where he finally came to rest in his old age. But the seeds he left for the future have surely grown into a great tree that shelters the world.
Fein seems to have begun looking toward the future, while keeping the wounds of his past hidden in his heart.
Through the journey to save the world, he must have realised anew not only what he needs, but also those who need him.
Now he seems to be trying to grasp something new, overcoming the grief of losing so many comrades and guiding young mages toward rebuilding the Guild. Someday his wounds will surely heal...
Not by forgetting, but by keeping what was precious deep in his heart...
A sense of guilt that would never heal, a world he could only dimly feel. For a long time these tormented Fein Lu Lugus.
But time passed, and little by little he found himself again. He never gave up searching for something in the future.
And, like his master, he resolved to entrust all his experience to young mages. Having guided many mages and become a great sorcerer, in his old age he returned to the tower,
the tower that held his warm memories...
Leyla Vigrid: caught up in the chaos as a knight of the Empire, she resolved to return to her own country.
The Empire was in utter chaos, but she worked to rebuild the nation together with people who shared her convictions.
She had not forgotten the Empire's crimes, but she felt her mission was to protect the ordinary people who lived there.
It took a long time for the country to find its calm again, but she never gave up and saw it through.
The knights were re-formed with her at their head, and she worked there for her country all her life.
To protect the future, to fight for what she believed in, and never to bow to any injustice: she passed those ideals on to the young knights.
Her will and her convictions, together with the knights, went on protecting the homeland she loved for a very long time.
I think Leyla must have agonised over whether or not to go back to the Empire... But she made up her mind: she would return to the imperial capital...
Through the journey to save the world, the world she had lived in was denied to her. Even I cannot fully understand that pain and suffering.
But now she knows who was truly hurt, and she has begun working to give those people back their smiles.
When she sets aside honor and pride, and strength and kindness become one, perhaps a new image of a knight will begin to take shape within her...
Leyla Vigrid, who had fought on through the war as a knight of the Empire, returned to her homeland.
But she never again took up the knight's post that had led to such a foolish war; she began living in the imperial capital as a simple noble.
The chaos in the Empire went on for a while, but it too subsided, and peaceful days returned. Her past as a knight already seems like something from long ago.
Now she believes that uneventful, peaceful days are more precious than anything.
Rudiere Legrance: his many trials had made the boy's heart grow greatly.
He had kept asking himself what he should do, and on his journey he seems to have found the answer.
It was to walk on his own feet the path his brother had aimed for. The path of a true king was not an easy one, but he overcame it with strong conviction and will.

He never ran from the loneliness of a king or the harsh decisions of a ruler, but faced them head-on. He made painful decisions without flinching and was often misunderstood, but he always put his convictions first.
As time went by, the people of Legrance came to praise him with pride.
And as the years went on, he left his name in history as a wise king without equal:
as a man who saw the world with true eyes, as a man of courage, and as a king who knew the sufferings of his people.
Rudi seems to have resolved to carry on his brother's will.
Through the journey to save the world, I think he was always thinking about how he differed from his brother, and about his own naivety.
Perhaps he has finally realised that those differences... that brightness and kindness... are things only he has...
A hard road surely lies ahead of him. But he always thinks of his people first.
He knows better than anyone what matters to the country. I will keep praying that his heart, which treats everyone alike, will grow into a great strength...
The young prince Rudiere Legrance was deeply troubled over whether or not he should take the throne.
